About this item

  • 【Tubing Size】5mm ID x 8mm OD pre-cut flexible silicone tubing, length : 10 Ft (3.05meters)
  • 【Eco-friendly Material】High quality food grade silicone, lightweight,UV resistant, does not deteriorate outdoors. Extremely durable.
  • 【High Temp resistance】High temperature silicone tubing. Provides excellent resistance to chemicals, solvents, alkalis, and acids. Smooth inner surface for easy flow and easy cleaning.
  • 【Food Grade silicone】Suitable for general low pressure industrial applications for the conveyance of chemicals, liquids, gases, and solids of suitable granular size, such as factory airline tubing automation machinery and pneumatic lines.
  • 【Widely Applications】Used for homebrew and beer brewing, aquarium air tubing, kegerator, wine making, milk or food handling and processing, pumps, siphon, drain valve connections, filters, plumbing, drip irrigation, etc. Great for fluid handling, water pump transfer, peristaltic pumps, siphoning, draining, aquaponics and water/oil change, etc.

    Product description

    • High temp food grade soft flexible and durable silicone tubing clear plastic tubes
    • Non-toxic,No Smell,High Intensity,Great Tenacity, BPA free
    • Healthy,Environmentally protection Industrial grade water hose
    • Heat resistant and cold resistant hose

    Size available: 0.5mm id x 2mm od 1mm id x 2mm 0d 1.5mm id x 3mm 0d 3mm id x 4mm od 3mm id x 5mm od 4mm id x 6mm od 5mm id x 7mm od 7mm id x 10mm od 8mm id x 12mm od 9mm id x 12mm od10mm id x 13mm od 12mm id x 16mm od plastic rubber silicone tubing

    Widely used in kegerator air line beverage, home drinking water, irrigation tubing, pure wine filter, drainage, factories, food machinery, laboratories ,brake bleeding system and transfer for food, aquarium silicone tubing, garden hose, humidifier tubing

    High temp resistance

    Can withstand temperature in the range of - 50 °C - 200 °C (-58°F to 392°F).

    Flexible Soft High Intensity

    Easy to use, shape, and bend and can be easily cut by any cutting tool.

    Suit for most of common barbed fittings and connectors.

    Food Grade Silicone

    Safe to use and well suited for beverage and brewing in the kitchen.

    Note: Make sure to always wash before use.

    Widely Applications

    Widely used for pumps, filters, AC and HVAC tubing, drain valve connections, filters, plumbing, drip irrigation, humidifiers, ponds and gardens, beer brewing, wine making, refrigeration, dental, industrial, medical, surgical, brake bleeding system, laboratory applications for transferring liquid.

      The arteries of my home brewery
      Reviewed in the United States on February 17, 2026
      Size: 8mm ID x 12mm ODStyle: 10 Ft/3.05M

      I decided to brew my own beer. I needed tubing to transfer the "wort" to the fermenter. This silicone tubing is the real deal.

      Quality:

      It’s food grade, so my beer won't taste like tires. It handles high heat—I ran boiling water through it and it didn't melt or get stiff.

      Flexibility:

      It’s super floppy, in a good way. It doesn't kink. I can route it around corners easily.

      Transparency:

      It’s clear enough that I can watch the liquid flow, which is surprisingly mesmerizing.

      This tubing is "beer-y" good. It’s a "pipe" dream come true.

      Due to the tight bundling of the tubing, some of the bends actually compressed, causing some inconsistency in the smoothness of the tubing. Fortunately, I was able to cut one portion away, and the other two spots did not disturb liquid flow. I created a mini water fountain stone sculpture, and needed to use this tubing to get the water from the pump to the top of the structure. The product worked fine. I'm glad there was more than ample length of tubing, since I had to cut off the damaged piece.

      Overall, satisfied with the tubing, but disappointed in the the tight bundling. Tubing appears to be of very good quality.

      Let’s be real: when you're ordering tubing, you're either building something awesome… or fixing something weird. For me? It was both. I needed reliable, food-grade silicone tubing for a hydroponic nutrient delivery setup and ended up finding uses for this Hooshing 8mm x 12mm line in everything from water pumps to PC coolant prototypes to makeshift air siphons. It’s like the zip ties of the fluid world—once you have it, you’ll keep finding reasons to use it.

      The tubing is super flexible without being floppy. It holds its shape but bends cleanly around tight corners—no crimping, no weird memory coil bends that fight you every inch. I’ve run it on submersible pumps, spliced it with barbed fittings, and even pressure-tested it for low PSI runs… no leaks, no splits, no drama.

    About this Item

    • 【Tubing Size】5mm ID x 8mm OD pre-cut flexible silicone tubing, length : 10 Ft (3.05meters)
    • 【Eco-friendly Material】High quality food grade silicone, lightweight,UV resistant, does not deteriorate outdoors. Extremely durable.
    • 【High Temp resistance】High temperature silicone tubing. Provides excellent resistance to chemicals, solvents, alkalis, and acids. Smooth inner surface for easy flow and easy cleaning.
    • 【Food Grade silicone】Suitable for general low pressure industrial applications for the conveyance of chemicals, liquids, gases, and solids of suitable granular size, such as factory airline tubing automation machinery and pneumatic lines.
    • 【Widely Applications】Used for homebrew and beer brewing, aquarium air tubing, kegerator, wine making, milk or food handling and processing, pumps, siphon, drain valve connections, filters, plumbing, drip irrigation, etc. Great for fluid handling, water pump transfer, peristaltic pumps, siphoning, draining, aquaponics and water/oil change, etc.
